role: context printed beside each ring-down verdict; the preregistered decision rule is untouched

pilot.edge_scope: absolute reference rate only; delta, its chi-square fits, A and T are unchanged

over_rotation_model: X90 and the final X90 or Y90 turn through pi/2 + eps/2; the rate error is the phase-error spread over 2001 phases divided by 2 pi SPAN x 20 ns
common_mode: Cancels in delta(tau), because the reference arm and every readout arm of a target share it: the static ZZ shift from neighbors that stay in |0> (every neighbor of a target is a spectator in |0>); the simultaneous-drive crosstalk of the shared X90 schedule, since every arm plays the same gates on the same targets at the same cycles; the coherent over-rotation, whose phase-estimate bias depends on the gate angle alone and is bounded above per qubit (over_rotation block); and the readout assignment, which the in-batch calibration inverts per target and which scales visibility without moving a phase. Does not cancel: the readout-induced effects of the other targets' simultaneous mid-circuit readouts, which the readout arms carry and the reference's wait does not, so they are part of what delta(tau) measures; and drift between batches, which the reference sharing a batch with tau 0 and tau 5 handles for those two arms and which moves delta(15), delta(40) and delta(100) together otherwise.

implied_t1.assumption: The implied T1 assumes the P(1|1) drop between the no-wait and the wait run comes only from T1 decay during the wait and that readout fidelity stayed constant between the runs; a readout-fidelity drift between the runs enters T1 directly.
